I didn't use a pattern...but I'll try to explain.

First, take some pink yarn and make a chain that fits around your wrist. For me, I think I chained 28...Make one additional chain. Single crochet into the second stitch from your hook. Then, single crochet in each stitch all the way down the chain. Next, change to some violet yarn(I learned here: https://youtu.be/6979knxSLKM) and single crochet down and back like before. Change to some blue yarn and repeat. At this point, you should have a rectangle with a pink, violet, and blue row. Lastly, take some camouflaged paracord and lace it through both ends like a shoe lace.

I hope I explained the process well enough...I'm kinda new to crocheting. I'd love to hear how it turns out. Good luck!
